verdict.rationale: The README shows `llama cli -hf <repo>` and `llama serve -hf <repo>`, which pull a GGUF model directly from a Hugging Face repo on the command line. That covers the download part of the story, but only as bare command examples without documentation. Nothing in the evidence shows searching for models or managing them locally. Missing for 10: CLI model search, local model management (listing, removing, updating cached models), documentation of the -hf download behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
